paraphrase: 'Nibbāna, nibbāna' it is said, friend Sāriputta; what is nibbāna? — The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion: this is called nibbāna.

original.text: “‘Nibbānaṁ, nibbānan’ti, āvuso sāriputta, vuccati. Katamaṁ nu kho, āvuso, nibbānan”ti? “Yo kho, āvuso, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo— idaṁ vuccati nibbānan”ti.
